Priya: Quick async Q3 OKR check — please drop a one-line status for your milestone (shipped / slipped / at-risk), blockers, next step, and owner. Consolidating for EOD exec sync.

Laila: Dedicated autoscaler -> shipped :tada: Canary completed in us-west-2. Metrics stable, 2% latency uplift only. Owner: Laila. No blockers.
Marcus: Region failover docs/playbook — at-risk. Waiting on infra-template changes from eng for <aws-account-id>. Owner: Marcus. Next: need PR from eng infra, ETA 24h.
Ava: Console telemetry UX tweaks — shipped but copy needs one more pass. Owner: Ava. Blocking: final legal copy. @Priya can we ship telemetry now and patch copy after?
Jon: Quantization test harness — slipped. Flaky on A100 sims, failing seed-dependent tests. Owner: Jon. Next: tighten randomness and re-run full suite, ETA +3d.
Priya: Thanks all — I'm tracking. Please reply with PR links when you have them. I'll put together a single table for the exec. Small ask: if you've shifted ETA, add a one-line note here.
Ethan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/642 — added kernel fallback. CI green for small repro, still running 8k test.

Ava: re: telemetry copy — legal approved a variant, we can patch tomorrow, shipping now works for product.
Jon: test harness update pushed to feature branch, will merge after one more run. ETA 36h.
Priya: great — marking runtime-v2 as slipped, autoscaler shipped, failover at-risk, telemetry shipped+patch, quant-tests slipped. Thanks :pray: 
Laila: :thumbsup:
Ethan: thanks, will keep thread updated.
Marcus: will chase infra reviewers.
